items.source:
Takes a prepared query, containing all the information about the cypher template to
be used, needed parameters and an optional mapping function, and turns it into an
executable query.
items.translation: 接收一个已准备的查询，其中包含用于 Cypher 模板的所有信息、所需参数以及可选的映射函数，并将其转换为可执行的查询。

items.source:
This package contains the core infrastructure for creating an
imperative or reactive client that can execute queries.
items.translation: 该包提供了创建可执行查询的指令式或响应式客户端的核心基础设施。
